hypothesis: Reasoning-free model-facing historical views preserve raw receipts, prevent bounded-view admission failures, and retain identifier-aware accuracy and efficiency gains against native convergence.
selection_rule: Source-only parquet projection of eight public task fields; exclude all prior G01 source-only task IDs; choose four previously unused, code-token-bearing titles from the hash-ordered remaining list, one per pinned repository; verify all base commits locally. No gold_context, patch, or test_patch inspection before the freeze.
decision_rule: Run and report all four matched pairs. Seal each final prediction or exact completed no-final-context result before pinned native scoring. Under the predeclared attempt-level policy, only exact completed instrument.no-final-context with known model-token receipts receives zero Span/File-F1; provider and infrastructure errors invalidate a pair. Aggregate pass requires all four pairs valid, candidate macro Span-F1 and File-F1 strictly above control, summed known model tokens and duration strictly below control, and no more than one Span-F1 regression. Report all invalid outcomes and policy-zero arms separately.
claim_ceiling: Four-task prospective G01 test of a reasoning-free historical view; not a repair of earlier campaigns, full ContextBench, or cross-benchmark ARE product proof.
